items.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) X8i instances are available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region. These instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors available only on AWS.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports managed observability and user management extensions for Slurm clusters
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports managed cluster extensions for Slurm clusters. You can install, configure, update, and remove managed features through the SageMaker AI console or API.

items.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports OpenSearch version 3.9
items.blurb: You can now run OpenSearch version 3.9 on Amazon OpenSearch Service. OpenSearch 3.9 helps you reduce vector memory and storage, evaluate search quality with more large language model (LLM) providers, build more responsive AI agents, and…

items.title: AWS Sign-In introduces configurable Sign-in duration of up to 90 days
items.blurb: AWS Sign-In now enables developers and AI agents to stay authenticated for up to 90 days without frequent sign-ins or consent prompts.

items.title: Amazon API Gateway announces API Portal
items.blurb: Today, Amazon API Gateway announces API Portal , a new feature that discovers, governs, and documents the APIs and AI endpoints behind Amazon API Gateway, Application Load Balancer, and Amazon CloudFront across your AWS organization.

items.title: AWS WAF introduces simplified pricing
items.blurb: AWS WAF now offers simplified pricing that follows what you protect instead of how you configure it.
